prose: Mario Garza of Symbolic Studies returns to InnerVerse to analyze the esoteric illustrations contained in the 1733 book, The Temple of the Muses. Mario recently gained access to this treasured tome, and in tonight's live episode we will explore the occult information encoded within its sublime sketches, which depict mythological mysteries and fantastic fables of the ancient world, many from Ovid's Metamorphoses.
The Plus+ Extension is streaming free for all, this time around!
